lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A matrix of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters is visible on the mid-lateral flank, arranged in approximately five discernible horizontal rows posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, forming a coordinate-like grid on the flank surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp intensity transition from light-valued pixels above to darker-valued shadow pixels below.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin features a high density of small, bright pixel clusters, with size increasing and density decreasing from the anterior to the posterior margin of the fin.
